title: Срочно нужен врач  (A Doctor Is Needed Urgently)

segments.t: When the inspector is knocked unconscious at the foot of the stairs, Mikhail rushes into the kitchen begging Chef Barinov to find a doctor without calling an ambulance. Meanwhile, Max and Kostya put tape over their captive's eyes so he cannot hypnotize them.
Я говорю, срочно в лобби нужен доктор!
Потому что мы до конца не знаем его возможности.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Step back! Misha, are you alive?' Barinov asks whether Misha are Mikhail alive, refusing to let the point slide. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
'God watches over drunkards.' Barinov mentions that someone watches over drunkards so Mikhail sees what is at stake.
'A doctor is needed in the lobby.' Claiming that a doctor is needed in the lobby sounds confident, even if Barinov has doubts.

'In what sense, Misha?' Over the shift and the doctor, Barinov presses Mikhail for a straight answer. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
Я говорю, срочно в лобби нужен доктор!

'I am saying, a doctor is urgently needed in the lobby!' Being saying a doctor is urgently needed in the lobby shows Mikhail is done holding back. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
'Ah, chef, I understood you.' Realizing that he understood Barinov changes how Senya handles the situation.
'The doctor will be there right now.' Noting that the doctor will be there right now keeps Senya's side of the story simple and clear.
'Thank you, hurry!' Around the shift and inspector, Mikhail makes his point loud and clear. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
'Why did you tape his eyes shut?' Wondering why Barinov tape his eyes shut cuts straight through the tension between Senya and Barinov.
Потому что мы до конца не знаем его возможности.
'Because we do not fully know his capabilities.' Saying that because they do not fully know his capabilities is how Barinov sets the tone with Mikhail.
'What if he hypnotizes with his eyes!' Over the moment and the doctor, Barinov lets his real feelings show. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
'Got it.' Around the plan and inspector, Senya sets a calm, everyday tone with Barinov. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Я говорю, срочно в лобби нужен доктор!
Потому что мы до конца не знаем его возможности.
And that finishes the scene in the kitchen and storage room. Notice how Mikhail urgently asks for a doctor in the lobby while Max explains why he taped the suspect's eyes. Until next time!
